claim: Patchline proves a backfill covers every pre-existing row before a migration flips a column to NOT NULL, so the constraint cannot fail on legacy data that the backfill missed. The worker compares the set of pre-existing row ids against the set the backfill actually wrote, declares completeness only when the backfilled set is a superset, and on failure returns the exact uncovered ids. The gate proves a complete backfill is certified with no uncovered rows and that a backfill missing one legacy row is rejected with that row reported.
